summary:
Architectural plan for Custom Root Pillars, Root Skills creation, and the All-Pillars Overview:
1. Data Model & Schema Enhancement: Supporting unlimited custom pillars (name, emoji, color, description, order, archive status) and root skills under any pillar. Safe unassigned archive reparenting on pillar deletion.
2. 3-Way Skills Navigation Toggle: Seamlessly switching between 'All Pillars' overview, hierarchical 'Outline', and radial SVG 'Mind Map'.
3. All-Pillars Overview Screen: Vertically scrollable multi-pillar dashboard with independent collapsible accordions, global skill search, compact/expanded modes, and 1-tap '+ Root Skill' and '+ Pillar' launchers.
4. Dynamic Today Progress Rings: Upgrading TodayScreen from hardcoded 3-pillar rings to dynamically computed SVG progress rings across all active default and custom pillars.
5. Contextual Modals: PillarEditorModal (create/edit/archive/delete with safety guard) and SkillEditorModal (create/move/nest/reorder).
